Mamas (and Papas), don't let your babies grow up to be brain-eaten tech zombies.
throughline.news/p/we-have-t…

I've been in Japan for almost a week and I'm sitting in a busy cafe and this is the first time I've heard someone playing their phone out loud. And of course it is a tourist. I truly wish they'd boot her out of the country.

"For kids with ADHD, the allure of YouTube on school devices can be especially challenging, several parents said. The school that Brenda Oswald’s son attends in Oregon requires iPad use for district-mandated digital curriculum. His grades have fluctuated wildly; he made the honor roll when the iPad was briefly removed, only to slide back as his school-day viewing surged to as much as 240 minutes in a single day.

“He feels like a failure,” Oswald said. She said an escalating regimen of ADHD medi

Your child -- and you -- cannot learn as well from a screen as from analog methods. It is literally short-circuiting your child's brain to give them screens instead of books. The tech and AI companies trying to take over your child's school *do not care.* They are predatory and should be treated as such. 
wsj.com/us-news/education/yo…

“To Google, the K-to-12 market and Chromebooks were a critical entry point for building lifelong brand loyalty, according to internal documents released during the social media trials. The company trained its eyes on children under 13 as the world’s fastest-growing internet audience. YouTube sought to close the 80 million-hours-per-day viewing gap between school days and weekends, according to a 2016 document entitled “YouTube edu opportunities”: “Increasing usage in schools M-F could decrease t

Of course having kids is in large part a question of values not means. But “I want to be financially stable before I have kids” is part of a coherent value system. Young people all over the world are delaying childbearing and having fewer children. There are a bunch of reasons for that, but one is that in today’s global economy it is usually rational to invest more resources in fewer children. I know we’ve talked about the sublimity of Japanese toilets but have we discussed the toilet paper in fancy Japanese restaurants? What kind of bespoke otoro-fed silkworms are spinning that cloud paper?
i was told by john roberts and sam alito that racism is over so i won't worry about white republicans in the south jumping over themselves to end black political representation wherever they can

Marking our 250th year by having the British King visit to remind us about the development of the rule of law, while the president reads lines presumably written by Stephen Miller about the transcendent nobility of the mythic English blood.
Call me when the NYT is ready for a "12 Bitches Who Were Right about Everything" piece.

I truly think we've made something special. So if this sounds like something you might like, I hope you take the leap and sign up. Full disclosure it's mostly women. Most come alone, some bring a friend. But you can come as you are, whoever you are, with whoever you want to come with.

Retreats are very very very fun and I hope you'll consider joining me! Not to toot my own horn too loudly but ever since my collaborator Emily and I hosted our first retreat together we've had multiple repeat retreaters return on every single retreat, and at this point we've done at least a dozen.

Imagine taking a week to have all of your needs met: someone offering you creative practice, someone offering you movement practice, dinner reservations made, interesting people around the table, wine poured on when you arrive. Space to make and move and be. onthegroundretreats.com/retreat/greece

I host writing and yoga retreats around the world. And no, "go on a yoga retreat" is not the answer to society-wide loneliness or burnout or any Big Huge Problems. But it is one way to give yourself a damn break. To have fun. To exhale. onthegroundretreats.com/retreat/greece

We hear a lot about loneliness epidemics, too much stress, too much time on screens, too little time with other people, too much work and not enough creation. One antidote: Travel to a magical place with a small group of people. Write. Move your body. Make lasting friendships.

"Instead of getting highly effective contraception methods to the country’s poorest women so that they may decide if and when to have children, Title X under Trump seems aimed at getting more women pregnant, whether they want to be or not."

By @jillfilipovic.bsky.social 

GIFT article.
"The old anti-abortion movement strategy was to attack contraception as immoral, though few Americans share that view. The new tactic is more MAHA-coded, and with a #pronatalist twist:" 1/2

This is a gift link!

The same reason they push viagra like dealers.

I talked with the iconic Jessica Yellin about the authoritarian impulse to target women, from ICE enforcement to Russia to Trump's America to the just-toppled Hungarian regime: 
newsnotnoisejessicayellin.substack.com/p/the-patter...

The Trump administration wants to take money that has long paid for modern contraception for low-income women and spend it on helping sperm swim better. This is not a joke. 
www.nytimes.com/2026/04/20/o...
"The guy ran for president! And still, when presented with an attractive woman on social media, he seems to have thought the appropriate response was, “Here, look, this is my penis""
“The impulse to send them seems to stem not from a desire to seduce but to subordinate-less mating dance than dominance ritual, a way to push a woman's boundaries and see what she'll tolerate.”
Thank you! It is all... very strange.
